summary: NFT Ltd, a Cayman-incorporated Hong Kong-based crypto asset firm listed on NYSE American under MI, filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a best-efforts offering of 1,890,000 units or pre-funded units, each unit combining one Class A ordinary share and one common warrant, priced at US$1.35 per unit. Pre-funded units priced at US$1.35 minus $0.04. The common warrants are exercisable at $1.35 and expire five years from issuance. This is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown, not a special situation. The company effected a 1-for-80 share consolidation on April 17, 2026. Risk-arb angle: pricing at a premium to the October 6 reference price of $1.23 implies deal dynamics and warrant overhang to monitor.
